values.note: Electric sites have 30- or 50-amp service; 'The electric sites for short term rental are ELECTRIC ONLY.' The other sites are primitive, riverfront and not.

hookups.source: https://lowwaterbridgecampground.com/camping-at-lwbc ('sites that are equipped with 30- or 50-amp electrical service'; 'The electric sites for short term rental are ELECTRIC ONLY'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Six full bathrooms with hot showers behind the office, plus four portable toilets at the primitive end. Wi-Fi near the office only. Office and store 8 AM - 8 PM; ice, firewood, ice cream parlor.

facilities.source: https://lowwaterbridgecampground.com/camping-at-lwbc ('Six full bathrooms with hot showers'; 'Potable Water is available and we have an RV Dump Station'; office 'also serves as a campground store'; FAQ 'we have Wi-Fi near the campground office'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Online through Firefly Reservations ('Reserve Today') or (540) 635-7277. Deposit is the first weekday night plus a $5 per-site reservation fee, non-refundable but transferable with 10 days' notice. Check-in 12:00-7:30 PM ($20 late check-in fee after the office closes), check-out 11 AM. Firefly lists Electric and Tent Site unit types.

summary: Confirmed 2026 fees as recorded (2026-10-13). Added 30/50-amp electric-only sites (no water or sewer at sites), showers, flush toilets, potable water, dump, store, wifi at the office, Firefly booking. Not stated: season dates, site count, max rig length, minimum stay.
